_comment: Latest published Aeon Orb image per hardware track. A running Orb fetches this over raw.githubusercontent.com and compares tracks.<track>.version against the number stamped in /etc/aeon-image-version. When it's higher, the console nudges the operator to grab the new image from Patreon (notify-only — the Orb never self-flashes). BUMP the per-track version here AND rebuild the image with a matching AEON_IMAGE_VERSION whenever you publish a new image to Patreon.

pi4.name: v111
pi4.notes: Raspberry Pi 4 (Bookworm). Model Share with signed publisher provenance, Aeon Bench, the WM8960 audio fix, and the full agentic computer-control stack.

pi5.name: v112
pi5.notes: Raspberry Pi 5 (Trixie). Everything in the Pi 4 image plus the Hailo super-app and the on-device vision / voice / UPS suite.
